capLoss.method: E[(B + F − cap)+] / bet: exact over entries that need no simulation + Monte Carlo of the triggered rounds with B < cap (mass 5.141e-3, 200,000 rounds sampled from the exact distributions, 0 above the cap); exact upper bound 0.01205% (Cauchy–Schwarz with the exact second moments and the reach upper bound)

stats.label: RTP
stats.method: uncapped 96.0682% (mc ± 0.0729%) = base 54.279% + feature 41.789% − cap 0.0000%. Base: exact closed form (exact.ts); feature: exact free-spins algebra (features.ts) over the mc feature distribution and the exact trigger law. Cap loss: E[(B + F − cap)+] / bet: exact over entries that need no simulation + Monte Carlo of the triggered rounds with B < cap (mass 5.141e-3, 200,000 rounds sampled from the exact distributions, 0 above the cap); exact upper bound 0.01205% (Cauchy–Schwarz with the exact second moments and the reach upper bound). No simulated round exceeded the cap, so the cap loss is reported as not observed and the RTP keeps the uncapped value and tier.

stats.label: Hit rate
stats.method: P(B > 0) + Σ_k P(B = 0, K = k)·(1 − P(F = 0 | k)) over the base distribution, P(F = 0) from the feature DP

stats.label: Win > stake rate
stats.method: P(X > stake): exact part 1.3348e-1 (base spin already > the stake) + Monte Carlo of the 3.892e-3 mass of triggered rounds that still depend on the feature: 200,000 rounds sampled from the mc base and mc feature distributions (features simulated spin by spin), weighted by that exact mass

stats.label: Volatility (SD per round, stakes)
stats.method: UNCAPPED: √(E[X²] − E[X]²), E[X²] = E[B²] + 2Σ_k E[B·1{K=k}]·E[F|k] + Σ_k P(K=k)·E[F²|k] (B ⟂ F given K), exact moments from the feature DP; the cap only lowers it

stats.label: Feature frequency
stats.method: 1 / P(K ≥ 4), P from the exact scatter-count convolution

stats.label: Average feature win
stats.method: E[F | trigger] / bet, uncapped (exact free-spins algebra)

stats.label: P(win ≥ 100×) per round
stats.method: P(X ≥ 100·stake): exact part 2.0000e-6 (base spin already ≥ 100×) + Monte Carlo of the 5.141e-3 mass of triggered rounds that still depend on the feature: 200,000 rounds sampled from the mc base and mc feature distributions (features simulated spin by spin), weighted by that exact mass

stats.label: Max win (declared cap)
stats.method: slot.config.json maxWinStakes; a round that reaches it ends and pays it

stats.label: P(reaching the max win) per round
stats.method: exact bounds: P(B ≥ cap) + Σ over triggered entries with B < cap of P(F ≥ cap − B), bounded below and above by the free-spins DP (retriggers and multipliers included) with each spin's m·W rounded down / up to a 2-stake grid (500 bins up to the cap); P(B ≥ cap) exact + Monte Carlo of the triggered rounds with B < cap (0 of 200,000 reached the cap)

stats.label: Dry streak p95 (longest miss run in 100)
stats.method: exact DP over the current miss run, rounds iid with P(miss) = 1 − hit rate = 0.650137; p95 = smallest L with P(longest ≤ L) ≥ 0.95; at hit rate ± 3 SE it is 14–14

stats.label: Session (median balance after 200 rounds from 100)
stats.method: 20,000 sessions of 200 rounds at 1 stake from 100 stakes, rounds sampled from the mc base and mc feature distributions, capped per round; a player whose balance is below 1 stake stops (bust); median with a distribution-free order-statistic 95% CI
